image_description: A side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) resting on a sandy or textured substrate. The fish displays characteristic vertical red/brown and white stripes across its body and fins. The dorsal fin spines are elongated and fanned out, though some appear slightly fused or irregular at the tips. The pectoral fins are large and fan-like. The head is visible with a prominent eye. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting shadows, and the image has a grainy, low-resolution quality typical of older digital photography or flash photography in low light.
